data.title: US blockade would be 'worse than war' for Islamic Republic, trade official says | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: “We must not get used to the blockade as we did with sanctions,” Majidreza Hariri told Iranian site Khabar Online. “We should impose the cost of lifting the blockade on the US, even through war."
